data.name: DatabaseDescription
data.value: For most businesses this computer is the right place.

data.name: SqliteDescription
data.value: No extra program is needed. Records stay on this computer and are backed up before every update.

data.name: SqlServerOption
data.value: Connect to a SQL Server database

data.name: SqlServerDescription
data.value: If your company has a SQL Server, ask your IT department for the connection details.

data.name: TestRequired
data.value: Test the connection before you continue.

data.name: DbWillBeCreated
data.value: Connection established. The database does not exist yet; it will be created.

data.name: DbLoginFailed
data.value: Could not log in. Check the user name and password.

data.name: DbServerNotFound
data.value: The server could not be reached. Check the server name and the network.

data.name: DbUnknownError
data.value: Could not connect. Check the details and try again.

data.name: ConnectionStringInvalid
data.value: The connection string could not be read. Check its format.

data.name: DatabaseNameRequired
data.value: The connection string must name a database (Database=…).

data.name: SettingsNotSaved
data.value: The setting could not be saved.

data.name: RestartingDescription
data.value: This takes a few seconds. Setup continues by itself.

data.name: RestartManual
data.value: The setting is saved. Restart Vyxum for it to take effect.

data.name: CompanyDescription
data.value: The company name appears on screens and reports.

data.name: CompanyNameTooLong
data.value: Company name is too long (at most 200 characters).

data.name: LocalOnly
data.value: Setup can only be done on the computer where Vyxum is installed.

data.name: AlreadyCompleted
data.value: Setup is already complete. Change settings on the Settings screen.

data.name: PrivacyNote
data.value: No data leaves this computer during setup.

data.name: ProductsDescription
data.value: Add the products you will choose when weighing. You can also add them later on the Products screen.

data.name: AboutSqlServerBackup
data.value: Backups of a SQL Server database are taken by your database administrator.

data.name: AboutNoBackup
data.value: No backup has been taken yet.

data.name: UpdateNote
data.value: Run the setup file of the new version; your records are kept and a backup is taken automatically first.

data.name: ScaleDescription
data.value: Vyxum reads the scale through a serial port or the network. If the scale is on and connected, it is found by itself.

data.name: ScaleLaterHint
data.value: You can also add a scale later under Settings, Devices.
